notes: Animal guessing game, same rules as Mazao. 'wapi' = where to see it in Tanzania, 'nini' = what it is known for. Have a Tanzanian editor check facts before launch. 'photo' is relative to app/.

animals.wapi: Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Ruaha, Tarangire na Nyerere (Selous).
animals.nini: Mfalme wa nyika. Dume ana manyoya mengi shingoni, na hunguruma kwa sauti kubwa.
animals.en_fact: King of the savanna; males have a big mane and a loud roar.

animals.nini: Mnyama wa taifa wa Tanzania, mwenye shingo ndefu kuliko mnyama yeyote.
animals.en_fact: Tanzania's national animal, with the longest neck of any animal.

animals.wapi: Mito na maziwa: Rufiji, Ruaha, Katavi na Ngorongoro.
animals.nini: Hukaa majini mchana kujikinga na jua, na hutoka usiku kula majani.
animals.en_fact: Stays in water by day and comes out at night to graze.

animals.nini: Huishi kwa makundi makubwa, na wakati mwingine huiba chakula cha wageni!
animals.en_fact: Lives in big troops and sometimes steals visitors' food.

animals.nini: Ana mistari myeusi na myeupe, na husafiri pamoja na nyumbu wakati wa msafara mkubwa.
animals.en_fact: Black-and-white stripes; migrates alongside the wildebeest.

animals.nini: Sauti yake usiku husikika kama kicheko. Yumo pia kwenye methali: 'Mfupa uliomshinda fisi...'
animals.en_fact: Its night call sounds like laughing; it also appears in a famous proverb.

animals.wapi: Mto Rufiji, Mto Ruaha, Ziwa Victoria na Katavi.
animals.nini: Hujificha majini huku macho na pua tu vikiwa juu ya maji.
animals.en_fact: Hides in the water with only its eyes and nostrils showing.
